description:
Auto-configuration for the LLM cost tracker: wires TrackedLlmClient, the
        UsageExtractors, MetricSink/MetricQueryService (Mongo or in-memory), and
        serves a metrics REST+UI on its own dedicated port via a lightweight
        embedded JDK HttpServer (deliberately not spring-boot-starter-web, so it
        never collides with the host app's own web stack and works even in
        non-web host apps).
